title: Read send, throw, and delegation calls
description: You can follow the concrete messages exchanged with three supplied generators.

steps.description: running_average keeps total, count, and avg. Each received number updates those locals before the next average is yielded.
The driver obtains an initial None, then sends five numbers. The displayed averages range from 10.00 through 30.00.
safe_counter yields n and increments it after resuming. A ValueError handler resets n to zero.

steps.question: After throw returns its reset yield, what does the next printed next(sc) show?
steps.answer: It shows 1. throw already resumed the generator to the yield of 0, and its return value was discarded.

steps.description: The recording prints the reset message followed by 1, 2, and 3. The driver then closes the counter.
gen_b yields b1, delegates to gen_a, and yields b2. The final displayed sequence is b1, a1, a2, b2.
